facts: Spread across fourteen islands where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea
worth_knowing: Founded as a city in 1252 by the statesman Birger Jarl. It hosts the annual Nobel Prize ceremonies, and its Vasa Museum is the most visited museum in Scandinavia.
